import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Define points and date
point1 = ee.Geometry.Point(-50.925784, 46.694935)
point2 = ee.Geometry.Point(-58.528990, 46.809436)
date = '2019-09-19'

# Get MODIS Aqua Ocean Color data
modis_col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point(-54.726887, 46.752185))  # Central point between both locations

# Check if collection is empty
if modis_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS ocean color data found for the date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the image and select Rrs_555 band (green reflectance sensitive to turbidity)
    image = modis_col.first().select('Rrs_555')
    
    # Extract reflectance values at both points
    val1 = image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
        geometry=point1,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Rrs_555').getInfo()
    
    val2 = image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
        geometry=point2,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Rrs_555').getInfo()
    
    # Check for valid data
    if val1 is None or val2 is None:
        print(f"Point1: {val1}, Point2: {val2}")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Point1 Rrs_555: {val1:.6f}")
        print(f"Point2 Rrs_555: {val2:.6f}")
        
        # Higher reflectance indicates more turbid/"milky" water
        if val1 > val2:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
